# Saransh Kawadkar — Portfolio

> Saransh Kawadkar is a full-stack software engineer who designs and builds reliable web systems, developer tooling, and automation using React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, and C++. This page lists the site's content in a machine- and LLM-friendly format.

- [Home](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/): Overview of Saransh Kawadkar, featured projects, and tech stack.
- [About](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/about): Background, experience, and work philosophy.
- [Projects](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/projects): Full list of engineering and product projects.
- [Services](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/services): Engineering services offered for hire.

## Projects

- [3DMGV](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/projects/3d-mgv): Linux-first toolchain that converts videos into textured 3D models with OpenMVG/OpenMVS and Python automation.
- [INRT](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/projects/inrt): Solana-based, blockchain-first banking prototype with a Flutter desktop client and on-chain programs for identity and fixed deposits.
- [PRPG](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/projects/prpg): Procedural RPG prototype in C++ with procedural generation, an OpenGL renderer, and local LLM-driven NPC behaviors.
- [Slate UI](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/projects/slate-ui): UI components / interfaces project.

## Services

- [Web systems](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/services/web-systems): End-to-end web application design, architecture, and delivery.
- [Application development](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/services/application-development): Cross-platform and desktop application development.
- [Engineering systems and tooling](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/services/engineering-systems-and-tooling): CI/CD, build pipelines, automation, and developer tooling.
- [Engineering problem solving](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/services/engineering-problem-solving): Debugging hard problems, performance work, and architectural guidance.
- [Test automation](https://saranshkawadkar.dev/services/test-automation): Automated testing strategies, E2E suites, and quality gates.
